name: Makita XCU03 / XCU04
blurb: 36 V (2×18 V) cordless saws: 12″, 14″ or 16″ bars, 3/8″ low-profile chain, .043″ (90PX) or .050″ (91PX), 46 / 52 / 56 drive links.
intro: Makita's XCU03 and XCU04 share one manual and one chain table. The XCU03 ships with a 14″ bar and the XCU04 with a 16″, and the manual approves 12″, 14″ and 16″ bars for both in two chain types: 90PX (.043″ gauge) and 91PX (.050″ gauge), both 3/8″ pitch, at 46, 52 and 56 drive links respectively. The gauge is the trap here: both loops look alike and are the same pitch, so check which groove your bar has — the bar part numbers differ between the two gauges.

bars.label: 12″ (90PX, .043″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 90PX, 46 drive links, bar part 165245-8, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 90PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.5 mm (11/64″; the manual prints it as 3/16″).

bars.label: 14″ (90PX, .043″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 90PX, 52 drive links, bar part 165246-6, .043″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 90PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.5 mm (11/64″; the manual prints it as 3/16″).

bars.label: 16″ (90PX, .043″)

bars.label: 12″ (91PX, .050″)
bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 91PX, 46 drive links, bar part 165200-0, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 91PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.0 mm (5/32″).

bars.note: Makita's manual: saw chain type 91PX, 52 drive links, bar part 165201-8, .050″ gauge, 3/8″ pitch, sprocket-nose bar. Echo's chart classes the 91PX chain code as 3/8″ low-profile. Recommended file: 4.0 mm (5/32″).
